phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio communication module for real-time soil moisture measurement and data transmission.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification captures the dominant industry form for soil moisture sensing systems used in precision agriculture, where capacitive probes are preferred for corrosion resistance and stability, combined with an embedded MCU for signal processing and a radio module (e.g. LoRa, Zigbee, or sub-GHz) for wireless communication. Such integrated sensor nodes have widespread adoption in smart farming IoT networks as of 2024.
